import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
path='seva_invoice_register_uncalculated.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Invoice Register', header=3)
# Clean
df = df.copy()
# Filter out rows where Invoice ID is NaN or starts with non-SEVA
def is_data_row(row):
    inv = str(row['Invoice ID']) if pd.notna(row['Invoice ID']) else ''
    # valid if starts with SEVA-
    return isinstance(row['Invoice ID'], str) and row['Invoice ID'].startswith('SEVA-')
df_data = df[df['Invoice ID'].astype(str).str.startswith('SEVA-', na=False)].copy()
# Ensure numeric
df_data['Quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df_data['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
df_data['Unit Rate (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(df_data['Unit Rate (INR)'], errors='coerce')
df_data = df_data.dropna(subset=['Quantity','Unit Rate (INR)'])
df_data['LineAmount'] = df_data['Quantity'] * df_data['Unit Rate (INR)']
total = df_data['LineAmount'].sum()
foreign = df_data[df_data['Funding Type'] == 'Foreign Grant']['LineAmount'].sum()
pct = foreign/total*100 if total else 0
print('rows', len(df_data))
print('total', total)
print('foreign', foreign)
print('pct', pct)
